messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate and schema errors on /v1/chat.generate in us-west starting 2141593600. Automatic fallback triggered to pinned variant 'redwood-instruct-v2' — incompatible with chat schema. Metrics: 5xx spike +1200% over baseline.
Aisha S: oncall here, looking. Paging Ben and Carlos. Any recent deploys that touch routing/pinning? @pd-bot escalate to P1.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P1 created, escalation routed to Aisha S (primary) and Ben T (secondary).
Ben T: saw the alert in console, pulling routing logs now. Quick question: was there a forced pin change yesterday?
Carlos M: I pushed an alias change last night (small tweak) but I didn't touch pins. Will check commit history.
Julian R: adding context — we've recently rolled a new fallback policy that allows cross-family fallbacks if capacity low. Might be related.
Olivia (SRE): Error samples from edge: `{"error":"schema_mismatch","expected":"chat_response","got":"instruction_response"}`. Downstream customers see 500s when client validates response JSON.
Maya (CS): Customer reports: "API returning 500s for chat endpoints since 19:00 UTC, several users impacted" — one paying account is seeing >50% failures.
Aisha S: Ok plan: (1) stop automatic fallback for chat routes in us-west (2) revert pinned variant for chat-prod-usw to previous chat-compatible version (3) open watch. Ben/Carlos can you do 1/2?
Ben T: running command to disable fallback for route:
```
rictl routing update --route chat-prod-usw --fallback-policy disabled --dry-run=false
```
Ben T: command applied, result: fallback-policy=disabled for chat-prod-usw. Confirming no further new fallbacks will be attempted.
Carlos M: checking pin history: pinned_variant for chat-prod-usw changed at 2141510000 to `redwood-instruct-v2` by ops-svc (automated canary). Previous pinned was `redwood-chat-v3`.
Julian R: that explains it — instruct variant is incompatible (expects instruction-style prompts -> returns different structured fields). When fallback kicked in, runtime didn't validate task compatibility, only model availability.
Olivia (SRE): initiating rollback of pinned variant to chat-compatible one:
```
rictl pin set --route chat-prod-usw --variant redwood-chat-v3 --author AishaS --reason "rollback incompatible pin"
```
Olivia (SRE): pin command succeeded, new pin=redwood-chat-v3.
Aisha S: re-run a few synthetic chat requests now to confirm.
Ben T: running synthetic test... sending 50 requests.
Ben T: results: 50/50 success, 200 OKs and chat schema good. 5xx rate dropping toward baseline.
Maya (CS): customers reporting recovery, CS notified major account and offered credit.
Julian R: root cause (preliminary): automated canary pinned an 'instruct' family variant to the generic 'conversational' route during a canary stage; our fallback policy allowed cross-family substitution under load, and runtime didn't check for task compatibility.
Carlos M: Ops note — the canary service used an alias that matched the model family but not the response contract. We'll add stricter alias->compatibility mapping.
Aisha S: immediate mitigations done. Next actions: 1) postmortem, 2) add validation to pin API to block incompatible family pins, 3) add runtime guard to reject fallbacks that change response contract, 4) update runbook + notify customers. Assign owners?
Julian R: I'll take the runtime guard (Julian).
Carlos M: I'll own pin-API validation change (Carlos).
Ben T: I'll update the fallback policy defaults to disallow cross-task fallbacks and add a feature flag for controlled rollouts (Ben).
Olivia (SRE): I'll draft incident timeline and update runbook (Olivia).
Maya (CS): I'll coordinate customer comms and prepare a follow-up note for impacted accounts.
Aisha S: handing off to 30-minute watch. If anything spikes re-open pager. Good triage, team.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Aisha S.
Julian R: follow-up item for postmortem: ensure canary automation has a contract check step and that canary rollbacks remove pins if unhealthy.
Carlos M: adding log sample we saw in routing service for clarity:
```
[2141593621] route=chat-prod-usw fallback_to=redwood-instruct-v2 reason=capacity_shortage task_match=false
```
Aisha S: note for postmortem: customer-impact window ~2141593600 -> 2141593780 (approx) — start mitigation at 2141593625, rollback pinned variant at 2141593650.
Olivia (SRE): Will schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
Maya (CS): CS message out to affected customers and escalation already sent to enterprise contact.
Ben T: verifying no residual 500s across regions — looks clean. Closing active mitigation, moving to RCA.
Aisha S: thanks everyone. Closing on-call handoff to Olivia for RCA and watch. :thumbsup:
